decision: The complete upstream change switches the initial-render hook from an Injector to an EnvironmentInjector. Owned legacy keeps the view-container Injector to preserve its existing constructor and uses a local helper that races zone stability with a stable afterNextRender callback, destroys the scheduled render handle on unsubscribe, and retains a zone-only fallback for a manually supplied injector without ApplicationRef. Angular 22.1.7 accepts a public Injector for afterNextRender. The modern substitution is not transplanted; this decision does not assert equivalent timing for every custom injector or view lifetime.

whole_hunk_analysis.upstream: The entire two-hunk parent changes the injected Injector field to EnvironmentInjector and changes the afterNextRender options argument; it adds no direct test or unrelated production change.
whole_hunk_analysis.tagged_legacy: The 16 legacy wrapper inherited the shared trigger with zone-stability scheduling, not this modern render-hook injector.
whole_hunk_analysis.current: The owned helper accepts the view-container Injector, checks public ApplicationRef, subscribes to zone.onStable, registers public afterNextRender and cancels the returned handle on unsubscribe. Angular 22.1.7 public AfterRenderOptions accepts Injector; EnvironmentInjector is also an Injector. The currently selected view injector can have view-scoped DestroyRef/ViewContext effects and is not presumed identical to EnvironmentInjector.
whole_hunk_analysis.bounded_observation: The committed 22.1.7 packed fixtures exercise opening, dynamic options, a selection subscribed before binding, immediate open/destroy and recreation in both Zone-backed and Zone-absent modes. The separate repaired source replay exercises public render/zone protocols and cancellation, with real constructor/DI and native scope expressly excluded. Neither result covers arbitrary custom environment or view injector contexts.
